reason: Caps, a human-approval queue and a kill switch in front of our own API is a few sprints for my team, and we'd own it outright. Yes, a competitor just shipped agent trading, but that pressure gets me to build faster. It doesn't get me to add another vendor line I have to defend against headcount.
objection: You want me to put a startup with no customers and no SOC 2 directly in the execution path of customer trades and payments. If your proxy goes down or makes a bad call, my compliance officer and my regulator come to me, not you. And the 'free' pilot ends in a letter of intent with a price on it.
would_change_my_mind: A regulated peer broker running it in production that will get on a call with me and vouch for it.
